tools.name: match_tenders
tools.description:
Rank open tenders against what a company actually does. Free, inside the weekly cap.

    acme.com.au". Give `company_url`

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "find_tenders" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Search open tenders across Australia and New Zealand. FREE, within the weekly cap. USE THIS WHEN someone asks what public-sector work is open: "any council drai…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-tenders" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_tenders, tender_sources · Private data: match_tenders · Public sink: buyer_awards · Destructive: tender_sources.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_tenders, tender_sources · Private data: match_tenders · Public sink: buyer_awards · Destructive: tender_sources

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_tenders" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
